title: Good bass players and Snags Jones
summary: He names bass players (Fulston, Scott, T-Boy) and discusses drummer Clifford Jones, known as Snag.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
